blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Humans naturally parse visual scenes into coherent individual objects rather than scattered features, a capability cognitive science calls object binding. While recent work shows that pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) intrinsically acquire this ability, how native self-attention computations mechanistically keep object instances separate remains unresolved. By studying this across eight pretrained ViTs, we found that instance separation is expressed more strongly in attention routing than in token content: selected query-key relations distinguish individual objects more reliably than value similarity or residual representations. Inside heads, patches belonging to one individual tend to read from a common image region, which we term their attention address. Visually distinct parts of one person share an address, whereas identical duplicated instances receive separate, movable addresses. These shared destinations arise in part because query interactions with the spatial structure of keys direct attention toward consistent regions for one object and elsewhere for another. In DINOv2 and most other backbones we tested, editing this query component at the selected head redirects its attention address toward another individual. Grouping patches by this query component separates same-category instances, reaching .615 FG-ARI versus .289 for the same clustering of final-layer features, which tend to merge them.
blocks.zh: 人类自然地将视觉场景剖析成连贯的单个物体而不是分散的特征,一种能力认知科学称物体绑定. 虽然最近的工作显示,预先训练过的视觉变形器(ViTs)在本质上获得了这种能力,但原生的自觉计算如何机械地使对象实例分离的问题仍未解决. 通过对8个经过预先训练的ViTs的研究,我们发现实例分离在注意的路由中比在符号内容中表达得更强烈:选定的查询键关系比价值相似或剩余表示更可靠地区分单个对象. 在头部内部,属于一个人的补丁往往从一个共同的图像区域读取,我们用这个区域来表示他们的注意力地址. 一人视似不同的部分共用一个地址,而相同的重复实例则得到单独的可移动地址。 产生这些共同目的地的部分原因是,对某一物体和另一物体其他地方的一致区域,对钥匙空间结构的相互作用进行查询。 在DINOv2和我们测试过的多数其他骨干中,在选定的头部编辑这个查询组件,将它的注意力地址重定向到另一个个人身上. 按此查询组件分组补丁将同一类实例分开,对于相同的组合最终层特征,其组合往往会合并,则达到615 FG-ARI对289.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An image can contain two zebras. However, labeling every relevant patch as zebra is not enough: the model must still associate each head, torso, and leg with the correct individual. This is the visual binding problem, representing not only what features are present, but which features belong together ( Treisman and Gelade, 1980 ; Greff et al., 2020 ) . This problem was tackled by Li et al. (2025) , who recovered patch-level same-object membership, IsSameObject , with a learned quadratic probe and connected it to attention. In contrast, our aim is to identify how existing ViT attention distinguishes individuals, then to explain and manipulate the part of its computation that directs where their patches read. We focus on objects of the same category. Nearby patches often belong to the same object, as do patches with similar semantics, and either cue can obscure whether an attention head distinguishes individuals. We therefore compare same-instance pairs of patches with pairs from different instances of one category in the same image and at exactly the same relative offset (same distance and direction). We call this controlled problem object individuation .
blocks.zh: 一个图像可以包含两个斑马. 然而,将每个相关补丁贴上斑马的标签是不够的:模型仍然必须把每个头,躯干,和腿与正确的个体联系起来. 这是视觉绑定问题,不仅代表了哪些特征存在,哪些特征属于一起(Treisman and Gelade,1980;Greff等,2020.). 李等人(2025年)利用一个有学问的四极探测器,回收了同平面物体IsSame Object(英语:IsSame Object),并将其与注意力相接。 相比之下,我们的目标是确定现有的VIT关注如何区分个人,然后解释和操纵其计算中引导其补丁读取的部分. 我们的重点是同类物体。 相近的补丁常常属于同一个对象,类似语义学的补丁也是一样,而任何一个提示都可能模糊注意头是否区分出个体. 因此,我们比较了同一图像和完全相同相对相抵(相距和相距相同)的一个类别不同实例中的同一类补丁和对等. 我们称之为受控问题 物体在分化。

blocks.en: We used Pascal VOC for development and held-out evaluation, and COCO for transfer and later analyses. Labels define the test and are used to select the layers, heads, and relations on the VOC development split. Evaluation uses disjoint held-out VOC images. COCO is not used for component selection unless stated otherwise. No binding predictor is trained.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The binding problem asks how visual features are organized into coherent objects, rather than represented independently ( Treisman and Gelade, 1980 ; Pylyshyn, 1989 ; Kahneman et al., 1992 ; Greff et al., 2020 ) . Li et al. (2025) decoded same-object membership from frozen ViTs with a quadratic probe and linked this signal to attention. Huang et al. (2026) formalized binding information, that is, which features belong to the same object, and measured it in ViT representations, while Tartaglini and A Lepori (2026) found mostly early heads that track continuity in synthetic stimuli and contribute to binding. We ask a more specific question: which native attention computations keep individuals of the same category apart, and how?
blocks.zh: 约束性的问题问道,视觉特征如何被组织成连贯的物体,而不是独立代表(Treisman and Gelade,1980;Pylyshyn,1989;Kahneman等,1992;Greff等,2020)。 李等编. (2025)用四极探测器从被冻结的ViTs中解码出同对象成员,并将此信号与注意相连接. Huang等 (2026年) 正式的绑定信息,即属于同物的特征,并用ViT表示来测量,而Tartaglini和A Lepori (2026年)发现大多是早期头部能跟踪合成刺激中的连续性并会促进绑定. 我们提出一个更具体的问题:哪一种本地注意力的计算将同一类别的个人分开,如何分开?

blocks.en: Object-centric learning makes object assignment explicit through representations such as slots ( Locatello et al., 2020 ; Seitzer et al., 2023 ) . Yet instance identity remains challenging: SemanticSlots ( Sabri et al., 2026 ) identified ambiguity between identical entities as a limitation of semantic retrieval, while SlotContrast ( Manasyan et al., 2025 ) used temporal consistency to preserve object identity across frames. Decoder comparisons in DINOSAUR-style systems ( Seitzer et al., 2023 ) also showed that the decoding choice can substantially change instance grouping. This motivates asking what instance information is already present in the pretrained ViT before an object-centric module decides what to preserve. Self-supervised ViTs already expose object structure through attention and feature affinities ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Siméoni et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Melas-Kyriazi et al., 2022 ) , while Object-DINO ( Rawlekar et al., 2026 ) finds complementary object information across Q, K, and V.
blocks.zh: 以对象为中心的学习通过插槽等表达方式使对象分配变得明确(Locellelo等,2020;Seitzer等,2023.). 然而,实例身份仍然具有挑战性:SemanticSlots(Sabri等,2026年)将相同实体之间的模糊性确定为语义检索的限制,而SlotContrast(Manasyan等,2025年)则使用时间一致性来保存跨帧的物体身份. 在DINOSAUR风格系统中的解码器比较(Seitzer等,2023年)也表明,解码选择可以实质性地改变实例分组. 这促使人们在以对象为中心的模块决定保存什么之前,询问在经过预先训练的VIT中已经存在什么样的实例信息. 自我监督 ViTs已经通过注意和特征亲和暴露出物体结构(Caron等,2021年;Siméoni等,2021年;Wang等,2022年;Melas-Kyriazi等,2022年;),而Object-DINO(Rawlekar等,2026年)则在整个Q,K,和V等地发现了互补的物体信息.

blocks.en: Zhang et al. (2024) found that Q/K carries strong spatial structure while V is more semantic. Pan et al. (2024) decomposed the native Q/K interaction and found that early layers attend more to similar tokens and late layers to dissimilar, contextual ones. Prior work also studied spatial structure in attention ( Cordonnier et al., 2020 ; d’Ascoli et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) . We examine how a pretrained head uses that structure to distinguish instances. Related mechanisms appear in language and VLMs: binding IDs link entities to attributes ( Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ) , while spatial IDs let VLMs retrieve particular visual objects ( Assouel et al., 2026 ) and reason about their locations ( Kang et al., 2026 ) . We study this inside the frozen visual encoder itself: which native attention components distinguish individual objects, where those objects are read from, and whether editing the query component that sets this reading redirects the head to another instance.
blocks.zh: 张等 (2024年)发现Q/K搭载了很强的空间结构而V的语义性更强. Pan等 (2024)分解了原生的Q/K相互作用,并发现早期地层更能接受相近的代币,而后地层更能接受相异的,上下文地层. 先前的工作还研究了注意的空间结构(Cordonnier等,2020年;d ' Ascoli等,2021年;Kim等,2023年)。 我们研究一个事先受过训练的头 如何用这个结构来区分情况 相关机制在语言和VLM中出现:绑定ID将实体与属性联系起来(冯和斯泰因哈特,2024年),而空间ID则让VLMs取回特定的可视物体(Assouel等,2026年)并解释其位置(Kang等,2026年). 我们在被冻结的视觉编码器内部研究这个问题:哪些原生的注意组件区分单个对象,这些对象从哪里读取,以及是否编辑设置此读取的查询组件将头重定向到另一个实例.

blocks.en: 3.2 A controlled test of object individuation
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 受控物体分离测试

blocks.en: We used the following experimental setup. A positive pair contains two patches from one annotated instance, while a negative pair contains patches from two different instances of the same category. All patches belong to foreground objects in the same image, and positive and negative pairs occur equally often at every relative offset, including its direction. For example, if two patches of zebra A are separated by ( + 3 , + 1 ) (+3,+1) , the comparison includes equally many cross-instance pairs with that offset. By doing this, category agreement, foreground membership, distance, and direction cannot solve the task. Each relation scores every pair, and we report the AUC of ranking positive above negative pairs, per image. Without offset matching, proximity alone reaches .79 .79 AUC on same-category COCO pairs, and matching reduces it to chance. Figure 2 illustrates the cues our controlled test removes.
blocks.zh: 我们用了以下实验装置。 正对包含来自一个注释实例的两个补丁,而负对包含来自同类的两个不同实例的补丁. 所有补丁都属于同一图像中的前地对象,正对和负对在每一个相对偏移时都同样地发生,包括其方向. 例如,如果将斑马A的两个补丁由(+3,+1)相分离出(+3,+1),比较内容同样包括了与该相抵消的交叉对等. 通过这样做,分类协议,前景成员,距离,方向无法解决任务. 每个关系得分每对, 我们报告AUC 排名正高于负对,每个图像。 在不相抵的情况下,仅靠相抵即可在同一类COCO对上达到.79.79AUC,相接则会降低概率. 图2显示了我们控制下的测试被删除的提示。

blocks.en: We evaluated frozen ViT-B backbones trained with DINO, DINOv2, DINOv2 with registers, DINOv3, MAE, CLIP, SigLIP, and supervised ImageNet classification. blocks.en: 4 Following where instance-sensitive heads read

blocks.en: What does an instance-sensitive head actually do? We now follow where each patch reads, with the same experimental setup as in Section 3 and the heads selected there kept frozen. blocks.en: 5 How a query specifies where to read
blocks.zh: 页:1 查询如何指定读取地点

blocks.en: The attention address summarizes where attention lands once the head has compared a query with every key in the image. It shows where a patch reads, not how the query–key computation chose that destination. How can patches that look different end up reading from the same region? Each query compares against a key at every image location. One simple hypothesis is that, for a patch on zebra A, these scores rise toward one region of the image and fall away from it, like a smooth peak, whatever that region contains. Scores of this kind would arise if part of each key encoded where its patch lies, and the query weighted this part to select a region. We first look for such a spatial pattern in the keys, then describe how each query uses it (Section 5.1 ). Because this description belongs to the query, we can compare it with the observed address (Section 5.2 ) and edit it (Section 6 ).

blocks.en: A key depends on both what is in the image and where its patch lies. To see what stays tied to location, we averaged keys from the same patch position across development images. Differences between images are reduced, while patterns that recur at the same positions remain. Content that often appears in one part of the image also affects this average. We therefore examine only whether a simple function of position describes the average key well. The form of this function matters because a query scores each location through the dot product with the key there: for a patch on zebra A to favor zebra A, these products must be higher on zebra A than elsewhere. A key that varies linearly with position lets a query favor only one side of the image. A quadratic form can also favor a region between the edges, such as one zebra, and is the lowest order that can do so. After the softmax, a quadratic score can form a Gaussian-shaped peak of attention anywhere in the image. The request θ i \theta_{i} is computed from the query and the fixed spatial basis: where the query would read if keys carried only their spatial pattern. blocks.en: A request that predicts the address could still be only a correlate of routing. To test whether it controls where the head reads, we took a source patch on person A and a donor patch on person B in each of the 215 COCO scenes, and compared two edits of the source query at L10h2 (Fig. 6 ). The request swap gives the source query the request of the donor, using the smallest query change that does so. The equal-size control changes the query by the same amount in random directions that leave its request unchanged. In both cases we edited only this query at this head, kept the image fixed, and reran the model.
blocks.zh: 预测地址的请求仍然可能只是路由的关联. 为了测试它是否控制了头部的读取位置,我们在215个COCO场景的每个场景中都取取取了人A的源补丁和人B的捐赠补丁,并比较了L10h2(图6)的源查询的两个编辑. 请求互换给源查询捐助者的请求,使用这样做的最小查询更改. 等同大小控制会以相同的量以随机方向更改查询,使其请求不变. 在这两种情况下,我们只在这个头编辑了这个查询,保持了图像的固定,并重置了模型.

blocks.en: After the request swap, attention shifts from A toward B, while after the equal-size control the original route stays largely unchanged. The predicted shift of the requested destination explains 82 % 82\% of the variation in the actual address shift, again without fitting anything between the two. Changing this component of the native query therefore changes where the head reads, and attention moves gradually as the edit is scaled. The same swap reverses the preference of the selected head in six of the other seven ViT-B backbones and in the larger DINOv2 ViT-L, and in all of these except SigLIP the requested destination also predicts the movement (Appendix E.2 ). Later instance-sensitive heads respond to this large edit but still prefer person A (Appendix E ), so the edit controls where this head reads, not an identity carried through the network.

blocks.en: If requests carry instance structure, a simple frozen grouping of them should separate repeated objects in a whole image. For each image, we clustered its patches by their request vectors θ i \theta_{i} with mean-shift, which does not need the number of objects. Its one parameter, a radius, is selected for each representation on labeled VOC development images and then frozen, and no segmentation model is trained (Appendix F ). We score instance assignment only among ground-truth foreground patches, with the foreground adjusted Rand index (FG-ARI).

Full attention patterns reach .649 .649 . Requests therefore better separate repeated instances that feature-based grouping tends to merge, in seven of eight backbones (Appendix F ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We studied how a pretrained ViT keeps two objects of the same category apart. With category and position controlled, selected heads separate them through where patches read more than through what they carry. Different-looking parts of one person read from a common place, their attention address, while identical copies read from different places. Part of each query, its spatial request, asks for a region of the image. In DINOv2 and most other backbones, this request predicts the address, and changing it redirects the head to the other object. Patches can thus agree on an object by reading from the same place, without looking alike.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了预先训练的VIT如何将两个同一类对象分开. 在控制类别和位置的情况下,被选中的头从补丁读取多于所携带内容的地方分开来. 一个人的不同外观部分从一个共同的地方读取,他们的注意力地址,而相同的副本则从不同的地方读取. 每个查询的一部分,其空间请求,都要求图像的一个区域. 在DINOv2和大多数其他主干线中,此请求预测地址,并更改后将头重定向到另一个对象. 因此,补丁可以通过从同一个地方读取一个对象来达成一致,而不看相像.

blocks.en: Requests separate repeated foreground instances well, but they do not by themselves recover complete object masks: background regions remain fragmented and object boundaries are imperfect. A natural direction is to identify complementary mechanisms for foreground/background separation and object boundaries, and combine them with instance-sensitive routing for stronger object discovery. Another is to test whether pretrained video models use similar routing to maintain object identity over time.
blocks.zh: 请求单独重复的前景实例很好,但它们本身并不能收回完整的对象口罩:背景区域仍然支离破碎,对象边界不完善. 一个自然的方向是确定前地/后地分离和物体边界的互补机制,并把它们与对实例敏感的路由结合起来,以更有力地发现物体。 另一个是测试预先训练的视频模型是否使用相类似的路由来在一段时间内保持对象身份.

It compares three pair tests on the 101 held-out VOC images, each with displacement matched. The instance test is the one of Section 3.2 . In the foreground test, a positive pair contains two foreground patches and a negative pair contains one foreground and one background patch. In the category test, both patches of every pair come from different instances, and only positive pairs share a category. All 101 images support the foreground test and 47 support the category test. Background here means no reliable foreground assignment, which includes mixed boundary patches, so this row compares patch pairs and is not a foreground segmentation.
blocks.zh: 图3的正确面板提出了一个补充性的问题:在同一对事件敏感的头部,路由方面和价值保存得最好? 它比较了101个被搁置的VOC图像的三对测试,每对测试都与迁移匹配. 实例测试是第3.2节的测试。 在前地测试中,正对包含两个前地补丁,负对包含一个前地补丁和一个后地补丁. 在类别测试中,每对的补丁都来自不同的实例,只有正对共享一个类别. 所有101个图像都支持前景测试,47个支持类别测试. 这里的背景意味着没有可靠的前地任务,它包括了混合的边界补丁,因此本行比较了补丁对而不是一个前地分出.

blocks.en: A.4 Does the result extend beyond the small VOC split?
blocks.zh: A.4 联合国 其结果是否超越了小的VOC分裂?

blocks.en: The development split is small on purpose, 102 VOC images. If instance-sensitive routing is already part of how a pretrained ViT works, a few images should be enough to find the heads that carry it, and those heads should then work unchanged on larger datasets. They do. With every choice frozen on VOC, routing exceeds value similarity in all eight backbones on the 1,414-image COCO test (Figure A.4 ). On the 530-image ADE20K test, routing also exceeds value similarity in every backbone.
blocks.zh: 开发分拆是故意小的,102VOC图像. 如果对实例敏感的路由已经是预先训练的ViT如何工作的一部分,那么一些图像应该足够找到携带它的头,那些头应该接着在更大的数据集上做不变的工作. 没错 由于VOC上的每个选择被冻结,在1,414-图像COCO测试(图A.4.)中,所有8个主干线的路由都超过了价值相似度。 在530-图像ADE20K测试中,路由也超过了每个骨干中的价值相似性.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Routing remains stronger than value similarity on the larger COCO test. Blue and red show the actual AUCs of the independently VOC-selected routing and value components.
blocks.zh: 图7:在大型COCO测试中,路线仍然比价值相似性强。 蓝色和红色显示独立VOC所选择的路由和值组件的实际AUC.

blocks.en: A.5 Model inputs and reproducibility
blocks.zh: A.5 模型投入和可复制性

blocks.en: All backbones are frozen public timm (Python Image Models) checkpoints in evaluation mode (Table A.5 ). Layers are numbered from 1 and heads from 0. Inputs are resized on the shorter side and center-cropped to a square: 196 196 pixels for patch-14 models and 224 224 for patch-16 models, giving 14 × 14 14\times 14 patches in both cases. Image resizing is bilinear and masks use nearest-neighbor resizing. Inputs use the channel normalization of each checkpoint. Learned absolute position embeddings are interpolated by timm when the grid changes, and DINOv3 uses its native rotary positions. DAVIS illustrations resize the full frame to a square. The higher-resolution examples use 392 392 -pixel DINOv2 inputs and a 28 × 28 28\times 28 grid with the same basis and radii.
blocks.zh: 所有骨干都是在评价模式(表A.5)中被冻结的公铁(Python Image Models)检查站. 图层由 1 来编号,而从 0 来编号。 输入器在更短的侧面被调整为平面并被中央挤入平面:196个像素用于补丁-14型,224个像素用于补丁-16型,在两种情况下都给出了14×1414相14相14补丁. 图像再大小是双线的,口罩使用近邻再大小. 投入使用每个检查站的信道正常化。 已学习到的绝对位置嵌入由timm在网格变化时插出,而DINOv3则使用其本土回旋位置. DAVIS 插图将全帧缩放为正方形. 高分辨的例子使用392 392 - 像素 DINov2 输入,以及一个28×28 28\times 28个网格,具有相同的基和弧度.

blocks.en: Q, K and V are captured at scaled dot-product attention, after the Q/K normalization of the architecture and the DINOv3 rotary embeddings. Prefix and register tokens take part in native attention. Spatial distributions then discard those destinations and renormalize over image patches, both for the attention address and for the requested destination.
blocks.zh: 在建筑的Q/K正常化和DINOv3回旋嵌入后,Q,K和V被以规模化的点产品关注来捕捉. 前缀和注册符章参与本土关注. 空间分布然后丢弃这些目的地,并在图像补丁上重新正常化,既用于注意地址,也用于请求的目的地。

blocks.en: Table 4: Frozen backbones used in the eight-model comparison.
blocks.zh: 表4:八相比较时使用的冷冻骨干.

blocks.en: Appendix B Where does instance-sensitive routing appear?
blocks.zh: 附录B 对实例敏感的路由在哪里出现?

blocks.en: The main comparison selects components on development images. Figure B shows the surrounding heads on the held-out set: strong instance discrimination is concentrated in a few heads rather than spread across attention. Figure B shows how the address field changes with depth in one fixed scene. The most instance-discriminative head can change with the scoring convention, so localization does not imply a unique head.
blocks.zh: 主比较在开发图像上选择组件. 图 B显示周围的头部被搁置:强烈的事例歧视集中在几个头部,而不是分散在注意力中。 图B显示了地址字段在一个固定场景中深度的变化. 最有实例性的歧视头会随着评分大会而改变,所以本地化并不意味着一个独特的头.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Instance-sensitive routing is localized. Each cell is the held-out same-instance AUC of one layer and head. The outlined square marks the component selected on the development split. Strong heads appear at different depths across pretraining methods, and most heads have weaker instance discrimination.
blocks.zh: 图8:注重实例的路由是本地化的。 每个牢房是一层和一层的同层AUC。 概述的方块标志着在开发分割上选定的部分。 强头出现在不同深度的训练前方法中,大多数头部存在较弱的事例歧视.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Object-specific address fields emerge through depth. At each layer the head is selected by direct-attention AUC on the same development split. All panels show the same held-out scene. Later DINOv2 heads form two compact destinations, but the pattern is neither universal nor monotonic.
blocks.zh: 图9 特定对象地址字段通过深度出现. 每层头由直接出勤的AUC在同一开发分裂上选择. 所有面板都显示同样的被搁置场景. 后来的DINOv2头会形成两个紧凑的目的地,但模式既非通用也非单调.

blocks.en: Appendix C What does the attention address capture?
blocks.zh: 附录C 关注地址是什么?

blocks.en: This appendix supports Section 4 . It compares full attention patterns with direct attention, tests whether locality alone explains the addresses, and describes the two tests of what the address tracks: different parts of one person and identical copies.
blocks.zh: 本附录支持第4节。 它将全关注模式与直接关注进行比较,测试单是局部是否解释地址,并描述了地址轨迹的两个测试:一个人的不同部分和完全相同的拷贝.

blocks.en: C.1 Is shared reading more informative than direct attention?
blocks.zh: 页:1 共享阅读是否比直接关注更能提供信息?

blocks.en: We compared the full attention patterns of two patches with the Bhattacharyya coefficient, ∑ k A ~ i ​ k ​ A ~ j ​ k \sum_{k}\sqrt{\widetilde{A}_{ik}\widetilde{A}_{jk}} ( Bhattacharyya, 1946 ) . This classical overlap measure has also been used to compare attention vectors across BERT heads ( Bian et al., 2021 ) . Here it compares different patches within one head. Table C.1 keeps the head selected by the original instance test fixed. Full attention patterns (shared reading) separate instances better than direct attention in 14 of 16 model–dataset comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了两个补丁的全部注意模式与 Bhattacharyya 系数, k K A ~ i k A ~ j k\ sum_{k}\ sqrt\ gladestilde{A}_{ik}\gladilde{A}_{jk}}} (Bhattacharyya,1946年). 这个经典的重叠度量法也被用来比较整个BERT头的注意向量(Bian等,2021年). 这里比较一个头内不同的补丁. 表 C.1保持原实例测试所选择的头部固定. 在16个模型-数据集比较中的14个模型中,完全关注模式(共享读取)比直接关注更好的单独实例.

blocks.en: Table 5: Full attention patterns strengthen the same-instance relation. Same-instance AUC at the head selected by the original test in each backbone, on the same matched pairs.
blocks.zh: 表5:全面关注模式加强了同样的关注关系。 相同的AUC在每根骨干上由原始测试所选择的头部,在同一匹配的对上.

blocks.en: C.2 Could local attention explain the addresses?
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 当地人能解释一下地址吗?

blocks.en: Could nearby patches share an address simply because attention stays nearby? We built a distance-only attention map for each query: nearby destinations receive more weight than distant ones, regardless of the image. We set its Gaussian width so that attention travels the same average distance as in the real head. A second control uses the attention maps that the head produces for another image, placed on the current grid. This keeps realistic reading patterns while breaking their connection to the current objects.
blocks.zh: 附近的补丁能否仅仅因为注意力留在附近而共享一个地址? 我们为每个查询绘制了一个只注意距离的地图:无论图像如何,附近的目的地比遥远的目的地获得更多的重量. 我们设定了它的高斯宽度,使得注意力的行走与真实头部的平均行走距离相同. 第二个控件使用头为另一个图像所制作的注意图,被放入当前网格. 这保持了现实的读取模式,同时打破了它们与当前对象的连接.

blocks.en: Both controls use the original 101 held-out images, selected heads and matched patch pairs. For reproducibility, each image borrows attention from the previous image in the saved list, with the first borrowing from the last. We compared patches by the distance between their resulting addresses. In DINOv2, real addresses reach .870 .870 AUC, versus .518 .518 for distance-only attention and .523 .523 for attention from another image. The real addresses outperform both controls in all eight backbones (Table C.2 ). They therefore reflect the current scene, beyond nearby patches tending to read nearby. Figures H and H show visual examples.
blocks.zh: 两种控件都使用原有的101个被扣出图像,所选头和相匹配的补丁对. 对于可复制性,每个图像都从所保存的列表中的上个图像中取出注意力,其中第一个是从上个图像中取出. 我们比较了补丁的距离 它们的地址。 在DINOv2中,真实地址达到870 . 870 AUC,相对于518 . 518表示只注意距离,而523 .523表示注意来自另一个图像. 真正的地址在所有8个主干线上都超过了两个控制(表C.2)。 因此,它们反映了目前的场景,超越了附近倾向于阅读的补丁. 图H和图H显示了视觉实例。

blocks.en: Table 6: Locality does not explain the addresses. Same-instance AUC of the attention address on the 101 held-out VOC images, at the head selected in each backbone.
blocks.zh: 表6:地点没有说明地址。 101个被搁置的VOC图像的注意地址的AUC的同名信息,位于每个骨干中选定的头部.

blocks.en: C.3 Different parts of the same person
blocks.zh: C.3 同一人的不同部分

blocks.en: Can two visually different parts of the same person share a destination? COCO keypoints let us test this while keeping the original same-instance comparison. We assigned patches to head, torso, arm or leg using visible keypoints: head and face keypoints define the head, shoulders and hips the torso, elbows and wrists the arms, and knees and ankles the legs. To avoid ambiguous assignments, patches must have at least 90 % 90\% instance purity, contain no annotated overlap, and lie within 2.5 patches of the nearest visible keypoint. These rules depend only on annotations, not on model scores. The labels approximate parts from keypoints and are not dense part masks.
blocks.zh: 同一人的两个视界不同的部分能否共享一个目的地? COCO的键点让我们测试一下,同时保持原始的同声比较. 我们用可见的键点为头部,躯干,手臂或腿分配了补丁:头和相向键点定义了头部,肩和臀部的躯干,肘和腕部的手臂,膝和踝部的腿. 为了避免模糊的任务,补丁必须至少有90%的 90\% 实例纯度,没有附加说明的重叠,并位于最接近可见键点的2.5个补丁中. 这些规则只取决于说明,而不是模型分数. 标签取自关键点的相近部分,不是密集的部分口罩.

blocks.en: Both positive and negative pairs connect different body parts. Within each image, we balanced the labels at every ordered part pair and exact signed offset, keeping up to 24 of each label per group, and required at least 12 pairs. Scanning all COCO validation images yields 215 scenes and 35,100 pairs. The same scenes support the intervention of Appendix E . On these pairs the request nearly matches the full attention pattern ( .942 .942 versus .945 .945 AUC).
blocks.zh: 正对和负对都连接了不同的身体部分. 在每个图像中,我们平衡每个订购部分对的标签和准确的签名相抵,保持每个组的每个标签最多24个,至少需要12个对. 扫描所有COCO验证图像产生215个场景和35100对. 同一场景支持附录E的干预. 在这些配对上,请求几乎与全注意力模式相匹配(942.942对945.945 AUC).

blocks.en: C.4 Identical copies
blocks.zh: C.4 同文副本

blocks.en: The copy test of Figure 4 removes appearance as an explanation for different addresses. Three complete COCO zebra cutouts were each placed on three natural backgrounds, giving nine combinations. Within a scene the two copies are pixel-identical, and only patches covered by the object mask are scored. All nine combinations yield separate, correctly ordered, movable addresses in DINOv2 (L10h2) and DINOv3 (L10h1). When one copy moves, its address shifts by 4.68 4.68 and 4.61 4.61 patches on average, respectively, while the address of the stationary copy shifts by .98 .98 and 1.22 1.22 . Figure 4 uses a fourth background, licensed for reproduction, and the zebra with the median score of the three.
blocks.zh: 图4的复制测试取消了外观作为不同地址的解释. 3个完整的COCO斑马被分别放入了3个自然背景,给出了9个组合. 在一个场景中,两个拷贝是像素-等同的,只有被物体口罩覆盖的补丁被打出. 所有9个组合在DINOv2(L10h2)和DINOv3(L10h1)中产生独立的,正确的订购的可移动地址. 当一份副本移动时,其地址分别平均换行4.68 4.68和4.61 4.61补丁,而固定副本的换行地址分别为:.98.98和1.22 1.22. 图4采用了第四个背景,获得再生许可,并有三分中分的斑马.

blocks.zh: 附录D 如何构建和验证空间请求?

blocks.en: D.2 Why use a quadratic function if two coefficients already separate instances?
blocks.zh: D.2 联合国 如果两个系数已经分开了, 为什么使用四进制函数 ?

blocks.en: Two slopes already separate instances well. Why keep curvature? Slopes can only tilt attention toward one side of the image, while curvature lets a query place a peak of attention around one region, such as its own object (Section 5.1 ). It also helps explain where attention goes, how it moves under edits, and which patches group together. Table D.2 compares linear, quadratic and cubic descriptions of the same head.
blocks.zh: 两个斜坡已经分开了 为什么保持曲率? 斯洛普斯只能将注意力倾斜到图像的一面,而曲率则让查询将注意力的峰值放置在一个区域周围,如它自己的对象(第5.1节. 这也帮助解释注意到哪里去,它如何在编辑下移动,以及哪个将群相接. 表D.2比较了同一头的线性、四面体和立方体描述。

Address error, in patches, and movement R 2 R^{2} use the 215 part scenes and the request swaps of Appendix E , with nothing fitted to the outcomes. Grouping uses the rule of Appendix F on all 1,587 COCO images. Bold marks the best value in each column.
blocks.zh: 表7:曲线有助于解释路线和分组。 密钥适配(Key fit)是每个描述所解释的开发平均密钥中变化的比例. 同级AUC比较了被搁置的VOC和被请求的目的地在一个人的不同部分(附录C.3.). 地址错误, 在补丁中, 和移动 R 2 R^{2} 使用 附录 E 的 215 部分场景和请求互换, 且没有匹配结果 。 分组对所有1,587个COCO图像采用附录F的规则. 粗体标出每列中的最佳值.

blocks.en: Curvature barely changes pairwise discrimination on VOC, but it improves the address prediction, the movement prediction and grouping. Cubic terms fit the average keys better still, but bring little change in routing prediction and no gain in grouping. These results favor the quadratic as a compact description.
blocks.zh: 曲率在VOC上几乎不会改变对等分辨,但它改善了地址预测,运动预测和分组. 立方体术语更适合平均键,但给路由预测带来微小变化,分组无益. 这些结果倾向于四重奏作为紧凑的描述.

blocks.en: Three additional controls examine simpler explanations. Architecture alone: the same construction in a seeded untrained network gives request AUCs of .517 .517 on VOC and .537 .537 on COCO. A fixed spatial pattern: assigning requests from another image to the current grid gives .530 .530 and .513 .513 . Category imbalance: also matching the actual category within each offset leaves .881 .881 and .841 .841 , on the 95 VOC and 1,263 COCO images with enough balanced pairs. blocks.en: All 1,587 grouping images contain two same-category instances with at least four reliable patches each. The 14 × 14 14\times 14 grid uses unique instance IDs and 60 % 60\% patch purity. Crowd-only pixels are ignored and smaller individual masks take precedence in overlaps. The pair test instead excludes ambiguous overlap pixels, so the two tests can select different images. Every method assigns every patch before scoring. blocks.en: G.1 Is the controlled test only about individuation?
blocks.zh: G.1 联合国 受控测试是否只涉及分化?

blocks.en: No. The controlled test removes category and position as cues, but what it finds is not specific to that setting. Keeping L10h2 and its spatial basis fixed, all four readouts also distinguish individuals when the negative object comes from another category (Table G.1 ). Request grouping likewise keeps its advantage across the most common object types (Figure F.2 ). The same routing therefore also separates objects of different categories.

blocks.en: G.2 How does this work differ from Li et al. (2025)?
blocks.zh: G.2 联合国 这项工作与李等(2025年)有何不同?

blocks.en: Li et al. (2025) studied whether object binding emerges in pretrained ViTs, and decoded same-object membership with a learned probe. We study a more specific question: which native heads keep two objects of the same category apart, and how do they do it (Table G.2 )? The two tasks differ most in their negative pairs. In our reconstruction of their ADE20K protocol, only 1.0 % 1.0\% of pairs come from two instances of one category, so success on that task does not by itself show individuation. The readouts also differ. Their probe is trained on object labels, while our spatial fit uses none and describes a component of the native query that we can edit. On identical objects, their probe loses the separation toward the top of the network, while the late-layer heads of Appendix C.4 still keep identical copies apart.
blocks.zh: Li等 (2025年)研究了物体绑定是否在被事先训练的ViTs中出现,并用有学识的探测器来解码同物体的会籍. 我们研究了一个更具体的问题:哪个土著头把同一类的两个物体分开,它们是如何做到的(表G.2)? 这两个任务在负对上差异最大. 在我们重建他们的 ADE20K 协议时, 仅有 1.0 % 1.0% 的配对来自一个类别的两个实例, 因此, 成功完成这个任务本身并不表明 分化 。 阅读内容也有所不同。 他们的探测器被训练在物体标签上,而我们的空间适合没有使用,并描述了我们可以编辑的本地查询的一个组件. 在相同的物体上,他们的探测器失去了向网络顶端的分离,而附录C.4的后层头部仍然将相同的拷贝分开.

blocks.en: G.3 Why does the controlled diagnostic matter?
blocks.zh: G.3 联合国 为什么受控制的诊断很重要?

blocks.en: A broad same-object test rewards any readout that knows category or nearness, so it can point to the wrong heads. Figure G.3 shows this for one query. With the pairs of Li et al. (2025) on our VOC images, category agreement alone reaches .948 .948 AUC, and the test selects L11h3 key similarity, which responds to both depicted buses. Once background pairs are removed, L10h2 attention rises to the top, but nearness still explains much of the score: nearby patches usually share an object. L9h7 key similarity shows this cue. It scores well while offsets are unmatched and drops once they are matched. With category and offset both controlled, L10h2 attention is still the selected head, and it reads from the bus of the query. The controls do not create the signal. They remove the easier cues, so that the selected head is the one that separates individuals.
blocks.zh: 一个广义的同对象测试奖励任何知道分类或相近的读取,从而可以指向错误的头. 图G.3显示一个查询。 随着我们VOC图像上李等(2025年)的配对,单类协议就达到了948 948 AUC,测试中选择了L11h3关键相近性,这与所描绘的两辆公交车都有反应. 一旦取出背景对子,L10h2的注意力会上升至上方,但相近性仍然解释了大部分分数:相邻的补丁通常共享一个对象. L9h7 密钥相似性显示此提示 。 它的分数很好,而抵消则无与伦比,一旦匹配就下降。 通过分类并抵消两个被控制,L10h2注意力仍然是被选中的头,它从查询总线上读取. 控制器不创建信号. 它们去掉更容易的提示,这样选定的头就是将个体分开的.

blocks.en: G.4 Why keep the full request if the destination is two-dimensional?
blocks.zh: G.4 联合国 如果目的地是二维的,为什么要保留完整的请求?

blocks.en: The requested destination says where a query reads. The full request also says how its preference spreads around that point: two requests can point to the same place while one favors a tight region and the other a wide one. For telling individuals apart, the destination is almost enough: on different parts of one person it reaches .940 .940 AUC, against .942 .942 for the full request. Curvature matters when we are interested in what attention does. With it, the requested destination predicts much better how the address moves under the request swap (Table D.2 ), and the full request groups repeated objects better than its destination alone ( .615 .615 versus .580 .580 FG-ARI). Cubic terms add no consistent gain. We keep the quadratic because it describes where and how a query reads, not because identity is five-dimensional.
blocks.zh: 请求的目的地是查询的内容 。 完整的请求还说明了它的优先选择如何围绕这一点展开:两个请求可以指向同一个地方,而一个请求倾向于紧凑的区域,另一个则倾向于宽广的区域. 将个人分开说,目的地几乎足够:在一个人的不同地方,目的地达到940-940AUC,而完全请求目的地为942-942。 当我们对注意力的作用感兴趣时,曲率很重要。 有了它,所请求的目的地预测地址如何在请求互换下移动(表D.2)要好得多,全部请求组重复的对象比仅它的目的地要好(615 6.615对580 FG-ARI). 立体词没有增加一致的收益. 我们保留四维数据是因为它描述了一个查询读取的地点和方式,而不是因为身份是五维的。

blocks.en: G.5 Is the selected head stable?
blocks.zh: G.5 联合国 被选中的头部稳定吗?

blocks.en: Heads and layers are chosen on the VOC development images, then kept fixed on held-out VOC and COCO. Across 1,000 random re-splits of the 203 VOC images into development and held-out halves, the development rule selects L10h2 attention every time. Across backbones, the rankings of all heads correlate at .93 .93 – .98 .98 between the two evaluation sets. In DINOv2, the selected head also has the strongest quadratic fit and request discrimination among all 144 heads (Figure D.3 ). Related instance-sensitive heads occur in the other backbones, although their locations differ. The result concerns a recurring organization of attention, not one universal head index.
blocks.zh: 在VOC开发图像上选择头和地层,然后固定在被搁置的VOC和COCO上. 超过1000个随机将203个VOC图像重分到开发并被搁置一半,开发规则每次都选择L10h2关注. 在整个骨干部门,所有头的排名都与两个评价组的.93.93-.98有关。 在DINOv2中,被选中的头部也有最强的四面体,要求在所有144个头部中实行歧视(图D.3). 其他骨干中也会出现相关的体会实例的头部,尽管其位置不同. 结果涉及关注的经常性组织,而不是一个普遍头指数。
